items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: We were a trombone with a mobiel named George Morris. Yeah, George Morris died, too.

ctx.x: So he had two trumpets, huh?

Oh, Mack had more than two trumpets. Once upon a time, he had four trumpets. He had a big band. A large band. He had, he had, about... Three or four trumpets and sax. My, uh, you know, three or four sax. But I was told... Oh, he had a large band there. At that particular... We were a trombone with a mobiel named George Morris. Yeah, George Morris died, too. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
And who else was in the band?
